card.name: Closing em dash after an aside
card.fires_on: The em dash that closes a parenthetical aside or introduces a restating phrase, after a list, example or clause in general prose. It is the second dash of a pair, or a dash that sets off an appositive.

modes.label: Closing dash of a pair
modes.description: The second em dash ends an inserted example list or aside and returns to the main sentence.
modes.example: food, water, shelter, education, and medical care<<—>>depends on our individual access to money,

modes.label: Dash introducing elaboration
modes.description: A single em dash after a noun or clause leads into a restatement, number or comment.
modes.example: world population increased from 1.5 billion to 6.8 billion people<<—>>more than a factor-of-four increase.

card.writes: It suppresses em-dash variants and favors runs of hyphens or dashes, so it seems to steer away from repeating another em dash.
card.plain: It marks the em dash that ends an aside or adds a clarifying phrase in ordinary prose.
